option_relations.rationale: The option describes a condition with repetitive monomorphic premature ventricular complexes and polymorphic ventricular tachycardia, matching the characteristics of Short-coupled Polymorphic Ventricular Tachycardia/Ventricular Fibrillation (SC-PMVT/VF).
The option describes Early Repolarization Syndrome, which is a known cause of ventricular arrhythmias and matches the leaf with the same label.
The option describes Idiopathic Ventricular Fibrillation, which is a condition characterized by ventricular fibrillation without a known cause, matching the leaf with the same label.

The option describes Catecholaminergic Polymorphic Ventricular Tachycardia (CPVT), which is a condition characterized by polymorphic ventricular tachycardia triggered by catecholamines, matching the leaf with the same label.
